slides.headline: POV: it looks perfect
slides.body: Check these before you fall in love.
slides.say: Picture this. You're at a viewing in George, and the house looks perfect.

slides.headline: Look past the fresh paint
slides.body: Ask when it was done, and why.
slides.say: Look past the fresh paint. Ask when it was done, and why.

slides.headline: Find the geyser
slides.body: Ask how old it is and where it sits.
slides.say: Find the geyser. Ask how old it is, and where it sits.

slides.headline: Look under the sink
slides.body: Leaks, swollen boards and damp marks.
slides.say: Open the cupboard under the kitchen sink. Look for leaks and swollen boards.
